title: Nasty Devastator!
html:
Image:Nasty devastator.jpg
Nasty Devastator!

The Nasty Devastator! is a big brother of the Fade Devastator!. It has a good ranged attack and usually appears in groups.

Race: Fade

Class: Ranged

Basic Types

Name Element Habitat
Nasty Devastator! Poison Mutant Mania offs

Tip: They are big and slow and gather in groups. AoE spells can devastate them and Ray of Gosh works very well.
